display_long_description:
Travel beyond the routine with TerraRoam, an immersive, true-to-scale VR travel experience that lets you explore the world as if you were there. Wander through cities and side streets, step into villages and countryside, venture into wilderness, and visit iconic landmarks and natural wonders across the globe. Unlike fixed-view experiences, TerraRoam gives you the freedom to move forward, look around, and explore at your own pace, making each destination feel more real, more relaxing, and more discoverable. Pause where something catches your eye, return to favorite places, and let curiosity guide the route. Whether you want to unwind after a long day, revisit places you miss, or satisfy your curiosity about somewhere new, TerraRoam turns every session into a moment of escape and wonder. From familiar streets to extraordinary landscapes, the world is always within reach. Put on your headset, choose a destination, and start discovering more—one place, one perspective, and one unforgettable journey at a time.
Note: This app uses data from Google StreetView but is not an official Google product.
